text: So sorry to bother you this late. I'm a foster carer and I've got a little girl, 10 months. I think something's not right with a rash she's got. There are little dark red dots on her tummy and a couple of purplish marks, a bit like bruises maybe. I pressed a glass on them like you're meant to and they didn't go away, I could still see them through it. I'm not sure if it's just her eczema though, her dry patches have been really flaring up and itchy this week. Her neck seems fine I think, she can look down at her feet ok. Sorry again, I just didn't know whether to wait till the morning.
